label: Diagram 42
caption: Diagram 42 Location of an oil-fired appliance in relation to its hearth. Minimum dimensions of the heat-resistant material in the hearth and the clear zone of non-combustible surface
description: The image is a plan view, with the word "Plan" printed to the right of the drawing. A grey square represents the hearth. Within it sits a white rectangle labelled "Appliance", with the word "Front" and a small downward arrow indicating the front of the appliance toward the bottom of the drawing. A pointer line from the left connects the label "Hearth surface free of combustible material" to a point on the grey surface beside the appliance. At the top right, the text "At least 150mm or to a suitably heat-resistant wall" is associated with two pairs of dimension arrows: a horizontal pair measuring the gap along the back and a vertical pair measuring the gap along the side, between the appliance and the edges of the grey square. At the bottom, the text "At least: 150mm; or 225mm for an appliance which provides space heating by means of visible flames or radiating elements" is linked by a pointer to a vertical double-headed arrow spanning the distance from the front edge of the appliance to the near edge of the hearth.
